as_told.title: Government group surveilling rooms with vacuum potentials since the '90s

plain: A group inside the US government is said to have been working since the 1990s on watching things through the quantum vacuum, the energy that physics says fills even empty space. Dave Rossi, a guest who says aliens taught him advanced physics, claims he knows this group. He says it twice in the same talk, and the second time he adds that the group has had "massive success" and that the technology is not a prototype but "established." If true, the government would have had a working tool like this for decades.
